feature.fate: Fate die — once a battle it rolls the d100 table.
feature.growth: Growth — +{{per}} on a max face, up to +{{cap}}
feature.prismatic: Prism — counts as any school and inherits the slot affinity
feature.legendary: Legendary — an aura in the colour of its school

active.flip: once a battle, flip to the opposite face
active.copy: once a battle, copy the higher neighbouring value
active.swap: once a battle, swap values with another die
active.bank: once a battle, bank this face against rerolls
active.split: once a battle, split into two grey d4

intentWhy.attack: Hits you for {{n}} — shield first, then hull.
intentWhy.attackSelf: Hits you for {{n}} and tears {{self}} off its own hull.
intentWhy.shieldAll: Puts {{n}} shield on every living enemy.
intentWhy.multi: {{k}} separate hits of {{n}} — {{total}} raw, each rolled against your evasion on its own.
intentWhy.charge: Charges up: its next attack lands doubled.
intentWhy.jamSlot: Jams {{n}} of your slots until the next turn.
intentWhy.lockDie: Locks one tray die for the turn — it cannot be placed or rerolled.
intentWhy.lockDieHighest: Locks your highest tray die for the turn.
intentWhy.summon: Calls in another ship, up to the field limit.
intentWhy.mirrorHalf: Throws back half the damage you dealt last turn, capped at {{cap}}.
intentWhy.stealScrap: Lifts {{n}} scrap out of your hold.
intentWhy.capShrink: Drops one slot a tier until the next turn.
intentWhy.twistDie: Rerolls one tray die and keeps the lower of the two values.
intentWhy.swapValues: Swaps the values of your highest and lowest tray dice.
intentWhy.storm: Nudges two random tray dice by ±1.
intentWhy.curseDie: Curses a tray die: −{{n}} to whatever it rolls.
intentWhy.shieldGate: Raises a gate at {{n}}: a hit under it deals nothing, a hit at or over it breaks the gate. Vulnerable ignores the gate.
intentWhy.mirrorSchool: Hits for the size of your largest school, capped at {{cap}}.
intentWhy.drainCharge: Drains {{n}} charge; if you had that much, it charges itself instead.
intentWhy.siphonShield: Takes up to {{n}} of your shield and adds it to its own.
intentWhy.bargain: Bills {{n}} scrap: pay it and the enemy heals {{heal}}, run dry and it hits you for {{n}}.
intentWhy.enrage: Enrages: +{{n}} to every hit it lands from now on.
intentWhy.hijack: Grabs your highest tray die and pins it into a slot of its choosing.
intentWhy.echoTotal: Echoes the damage you dealt last turn, capped at {{n}}.
intentWhy.foldOrder: Folds the resolution order for two turns.
intentWhy.devourDie: Eats your highest tray die: it drops to 1 and the enemy gains that much shield.

aura.atk+2: +2 to every hit this enemy lands.
aura.atk+3: +3 to every hit this enemy lands.
aura.shieldAllies3: Every turn: +3 shield to every living enemy.
aura.shieldSelf6: Every turn: +6 shield to its owner.
aura.lockEachTurn: Every turn: locks one of your tray dice.
aura.lockEvery3: Every third turn: locks one of your tray dice.
aura.twistEachTurn: Every turn: rerolls one tray die and keeps the lower value.
aura.chargeAllies: Every third turn: charges every living enemy.
aura.summonEvery4: Every fourth turn: calls in an acolyte.

partDeath.enrageCore: Breaking it enrages the core: +{{n}} to every later hit.
partDeath.openCore: Breaking it opens the core for {{turns}} turns.
partDeath.shieldCore: Breaking it feeds the core {{n}} shield.
partDeath.spawnAdds: Breaking it calls in another ship.

coreSealedWhy: The hull stays shut until {{n}} more of its parts break.
coreOpenWhy: The hull stays open until the end of turn {{n}}.

statusDesc.burn: Ticks damage at the end of each enemy turn.
statusDesc.mark: Every hit on this enemy deals +N, and it ignores a shield gate.
statusDesc.jam: Its next attack is weaker by 2.

tideWhy: +10% enemy hull per level and +{{n}} flat damage per hit. Now: +{{pct}}% hull, +{{n}} damage.
interferenceWhy: Skipped anomalies stack up: every stack adds another tide level for the rest of the run. Clear an anomaly to drop them all.
axisWhy: Black dice pull toward Resonance, blue toward Stability. Events and drift move it too.
chargeWhy: Spend charge on actions: a nudge of one face up or down costs {{n}}, a bought reroll costs {{reroll}}, a surge costs {{surge}}.
mkWhy: Mk raises the slot cap and the affinity bonus of its school.
manoeuvreWhy: A die in Engines sets one evasion roll per incoming hit: glancing {{glancing}}% × value (max {{glancingCap}}%), dodge {{dodge}}% × value (max {{dodgeCap}}%). A glancing hit takes half, rounded up, a dodge takes nothing, anything else lands in full. From value {{intercept}} the turn's first successful evasion — glancing or dodge — is an intercept: Weapons +{{interceptBonus}} next turn. Value is the die after affinity and bonuses.
manoeuvreBrief: One evasion roll per hit: glancing {{glancing}}% × value (cap {{glancingCap}}%), dodge {{dodge}}% × value (cap {{dodgeCap}}%). A glance halves it, a dodge negates it. From {{intercept}} the first evasion pays Weapons +{{interceptBonus}}.
targetingWhy: A die in Sensors makes the target Vulnerable +D for the turn: D is half the die value rounded up, capped at {{cap}}, and every hit this turn deals that much more. On the die’s max face the hit also pierces the shield.
targetingBrief: Sensors mark the target: Vulnerable +D for the turn, D is half the die value rounded up, cap {{cap}}. Every hit this turn deals that much more; the die's max face also pierces the shield.

weaponA.what: Your main gun: the die's value becomes damage on the chosen target. It fires right after Sensors, ahead of every other weapon.

weaponB.what: Your second gun, built like Weapon A: the die's value becomes damage. It fires right after Weapon A, at whatever that shot left standing.

spinal.what: A keel-length cannon that takes the biggest dice on the ship. A low roll wedges it; a clean shot drives the whole value into the target.
spinal.jam: The spinal mount wedges on a value of {{jamOn}} or less, bonuses included: it fires nothing this turn and its next shot gets +{{carry}}, which keeps stacking while it keeps wedging. Above that it hits for the value plus bonuses, with the target's Vulnerable added and ×{{crit}} on a critical hit. It has no fire modes.
spinal.mk: Mk never lifts the spinal mount's cap — it takes up to d{{cap}} at every level — but it does raise red's affinity bonus here.

weapons.damage: Damage is the die's value plus its bonuses, shaped by the armed fire mode. Each hit adds the target's Vulnerable, a critical hit multiplies the total by ×{{crit}}, rounded down, and the enemy's shield soaks damage before its hull.
weapons.affinity: Red dice add +{{mk1}} to their value here at Mk1, +{{mk2}} at Mk2 and +{{mk3}} at Mk3. A prismatic die counts as red in this slot.

shields.what: Your shield generator: the die's value becomes shield for this turn. Enemy hits spend it before they reach the hull.
shields.gain: A die in Shields adds its value, plus bonuses, to your shield. Every shield slot feeds the same shield.
shields.keep: Shield lasts through the enemy's turn only: whatever is left when that turn ends is lost, unless something keeps a share of it or blue resonance has laid a lasting layer.
shields.affinity: Blue dice add +{{mk1}} here at Mk1, +{{mk2}} at Mk2 and +{{mk3}} at Mk3. A prismatic die counts as blue in this slot.

shieldsB.what: A second shield generator. It stacks on the first: both pour into the same shield.

engines.what: Your drive: the die's value sets the chance to glance or dodge each enemy hit this turn. A high value can also intercept.
engines.affinity: Green dice add +{{mk1}} here at Mk1, +{{mk2}} at Mk2 and +{{mk3}} at Mk3. A prismatic die counts as green in this slot.
engines.flat: This ship and build shift dodge by {{n}}% and glancing by half of that, before the caps.

enginesB.what: A second drive. Its value adds to the first engine's, and the sum sets one evasion for the turn.

sensors.what: Your targeting array: it marks the target Vulnerable before any weapon fires, so every hit this turn lands the mark on top.
sensors.fog: Sensors also light the map: you see {{base}} rows ahead at Mk1 and {{perMk}} more for every Mk above it.
sensors.affinity: Grey dice add +{{mk1}} here at Mk1, +{{mk2}} at Mk2 and +{{mk3}} at Mk3. A prismatic die counts as grey in this slot.

reactor.what: Your power plant: the die's value becomes charge. Charge pays for nudges, rerolls, surges and some officer actions.
reactor.store: A die in the Reactor stores its value as charge, after any multiplier and rounded down. Charge stops at the cap ({{cap}}); a store that overflows it wastes the rest and costs {{overflow}} hull.
reactor.affinity: Black dice store ×{{mult}} charge here at every Mk. A prismatic die counts as black in this slot.
reactor.mk: Mk raises the reactor's cap; black's ×{{mult}} charge stays the same at every level.

repairBay.what: An on-board workshop: the die patches your hull. It works last in your turn, after every other system.
repairBay.repair: A die in the Repair Bay mends hull equal to its value ÷ {{divisor}}, rounded up, never past your maximum.
repairBay.mk: Mk raises the repair bay's cap. No school has an affinity here, so the cap is all it adds.

system.fit: A die fits when its size is at or under the slot's cap. A bigger die goes in only through a rule that lifts the cap — a ship passive, a perk, a module or a chart node — and most of them charge hull for it.

echo.open: Drawn from its pattern — it is not fixed.

bag.label: Hand: {{bag}} in the bag, {{discard}} discarded
bag.title: Hand — {{n}} dice
bag.hint: Seven dice come to the table each turn, drawn from the bag. Placed and unused dice go to the discard; when the bag runs dry the discard is shuffled back in.
